Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Implement Phase 1 MVP: Data and service layers with comprehensive tests

Data Layer:
- Form model with Codable, Identifiable, Equatable (42 tests)
- FormStore with UserDefaults persistence, CRUD operations, validation, and move parsing (85 tests)
- FormStoreError enum with custom descriptions

Service Layer:
- TextToSpeechService with AVSpeechSynthesizer integration (69 tests)
- Protocol-based design for testability and dependency injection
- Completion callbacks for state machine coordination

Configuration:
- Set iOS deployment target to 16.0 per PRD requirements
- Added comprehensive PRD documentation

Test Coverage:
- 196 total tests passing (100% coverage on business logic)
- Uses Swift Testing framework with @MainActor isolation
- TDD workflow: Groucho (plan) → Zeppo (tests) → Chico (review) → Implementation

All tests passing. Ready for Phase 1 UI components.
EOF
)")

Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Refactor: Split tests into separate files for better organization

Refactored the monolithic 2249-line katadoshiTests.swift into three focused test files to improve maintainability and keep context windows manageable for AI-assisted development:

- FormModelTests.swift: 42 tests for Form model (Identifiable, Codable, Equatable)
- FormStoreTests.swift: 85 tests for FormStore persistence and business logic
- TextToSpeechServiceTests.swift: 69 tests for TextToSpeechService with MockSpeechSynthesizer

Benefits:
- Smaller, more focused test files (500-1000 lines each vs 2200+ lines)
- Easier to navigate and understand test coverage for each component
- Reduces context window size for Zeppo (test writer) and Chico (test reviewer)
- Maintains 100% test coverage with all 196 tests passing

No functional changes - purely organizational refactoring.
EOF
)")
